title: FFXII Westersand
description: Slayerdragon & Noctali's Final Fantasy XII escape: the desert and its volcano hall dragon, the tomb with Belias and Gabranth, and the airship with Gabranth again and the Chaos laser fight. Five stages cycle (normal, tomb, epic, god, zombie mode) with an insane difficulty on top.

scenarios.name: Chaos – laser boss
scenarios.summary: Jump or crouch Chaos's deck lasers
scenarios.description: The airship finale's Chaos fight. A random laser (low, mid or high) fires down the deck every 1.2 s until Chaos dies: jump the low and mid ones, crouch the high one. 380 hits per segment at 20 humans (50 + 16.5 per human, from the map's HP trigger), 6 segments; the 25 s Holy hit takes off 9 × 125.

scenarios.name: Laser stream only
scenarios.summary: Just the lasers: jump low, crouch high
scenarios.description: Chaos's laser timer with no HP to shoot: a random low / mid / high laser every 1.2 s for 40 s.

scenarios.name: Dragon – desert hall
scenarios.summary: Dragon fight in the volcano hall
scenarios.description: The stage-1 dragon in the volcano hall. An attack every 7 s (fire on the left or right half, electro floor, lure, wind, heal, water) and a fire nova or meteor after every 4th. 50 + 43 HP per human per segment, 6 segments; 80 s after it lands Holy goes off, and 20 s later the hall is nuked if it still lives. You start in the hall door (its HP trigger) 4 s before it closes; anyone still in the corridor at 54 s is sent to the zombie cage.

scenarios.name: Fire – one half
scenarios.summary: Fire on one half: switch sides
scenarios.description: Fire on the right half of the hall (0.2–5 s, 30/s): get to the other side.

scenarios.name: Electro floor
scenarios.description: The electro floor (0.2–5 s, 25/s) starts 59 u above the floor: crouch.

scenarios.name: Desert ending – dragon and guard lasers
scenarios.summary: Kill the crawling dragon, then guard lasers
scenarios.description: The 80 s hold at the end of the stage-1 road. A dragon wakes at 12 s and crawls down the road (touching it kills): kill it within 20 s (50 + 15 HP per human, 6 segments) or Holy nukes everyone. Fireballs roll down the road. At 74–76 s the guard fires 3 random lasers across the end platform (low: jump, high: crouch); the end trigger opens at 80 s.

scenarios.name: Guard lasers
scenarios.summary: Three random guard lasers: jump or crouch
scenarios.description: The guard's 3 random lasers at 3, 4 and 5 s, sweeping the end platform at 1300 u/s. Low ones (39–47 u up): jump. High ones (59–99 u): crouch.

scenarios.name: Guard lasers (insane)
scenarios.description: The insane version: lasers at 3, 3.85 and 4.7 s, sped up to 1400 u/s.

scenarios.name: Belias
scenarios.summary: Fire esper: firewaves, lures, falling tiles
scenarios.description: The tomb's fire esper. The fight starts 10 s after the first human enters. Every 5 s a random attack (firewave sweep either way, a lure into an explosion, falling tiles), and a random firewave every 2 s between. At 1 segment left he goes critical for 20 s (immune) and the attacks speed up. 50 + 43 HP per human per segment, 6 segments.

scenarios.name: Firewave sweep
scenarios.description: Eight firewaves, one every 0.15 s, sweeping across the arena.

scenarios.name: Firewave sweep (other way)
scenarios.summary: Firewaves sweeping from the far side
scenarios.description: The same sweep from the far side.

scenarios.name: Lure + explosion
scenarios.summary: Resist the pull, escape the explosions
scenarios.description: A 3.5 s pull toward Belias, then three explosions in front of him at 4.25 s.

scenarios.name: Falling tiles
scenarios.summary: Dodge tiles falling from the ceiling
scenarios.description: Eight random tiles of the 12 drop from the ceiling over 1 s.

scenarios.name: Critical: the X-zone
scenarios.description: Belias at his last segment: 3 s in, everyone in the arena is teleported to the X-zone, where Belias's fire (600 damage on touch) rolls through and explosions go off for 17 s, then you are sent back to the arena.

scenarios.name: Gabranth – tomb chase
scenarios.summary: Stop Gabranth's charge down the corridor
scenarios.description: 99 s after Belias falls, Gabranth charges down the tomb corridor (350 u/s, touching him kills). Kill him before he reaches the end, about 10 s, or the tomb is nuked. 5 + 6 HP per human per segment (125 at 20 humans), 6 segments. On death he fires one last laser down the corridor.

scenarios.name: Last laser
scenarios.summary: His parting laser: jump or crouch
scenarios.description: Gabranth's parting shot: one random laser (low: jump, high: crouch) down the corridor at 2000 u/s.

scenarios.name: Gabranth – airship boss
scenarios.summary: Kite Gabranth around the airship ring
scenarios.description: The airship's Gabranth (Epic, normal difficulty): he chases the team round the ring (120-damage touch) while a random summon attack lands every 10.5 s. 50 + 30 HP per human per segment, 6 segments.

scenarios.name: Chaos → plate escape (Epic ending)
scenarios.summary: Chaos fight, then jump to the plate
scenarios.description: Chaos fight, then the run to the plate under it (Chaos_End_Epic): the plate rises 5 s after the first human reaches it and the airship is nuked 3.5 s later. The plate is across the void from the deck: jump the stepping stones. Win on the plate.
